title: ticfac Phase 5: Cloudflare Computer executor
description: SPEC §12 Phase 5 and §8.3-8.7. Computer executor without changing Job* or role contracts; pin the preview dependency; test Workspace persistence, explicit backend routing, cancellation, inspection/adoption, collection, disposal; phase-aware isolate-to-container promotion, container kept hot through RGR/TDD; shadow the Sandbox executor before changing defaults. Re-read §8.3-8.5 against the API that actually ships before implementing.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: the Phase 4 gate run repeated on the Computer executor, shadowed against Sandbox, with matching evidence.
notes: 2026-09-17 - MOVED from the ticks tracker to ticfac's own. The ticfac phase ladder was being tracked in ticks under task hzm, which is why ticfac's roadmap showed no Cloudflare work at all. The phases now sit as top-level epics here, alongside qeu (Phase 1), av8 (Phase 2) and 9pd (Phase 3). Nothing in the family referenced anything outside it and no id collided, so the move is the files plus two re-pointings: the parent hzm is dropped, and ncv's blocker becomes 9pd.
